rule.urgent: loss confirmed on sub-metre imagery and >= 10 ha of cells in decline
rule.monitor: smaller confirmed loss, or cells in decline not yet checked
rule.closed: checked by a person and closed with a reason

note: Cases stay open until a person closes them with a reason. Screening indicator, not ground truth. Prioritisation added after expert evaluation and feedback from the Bahrain Space Agency.
